note: Estimates, not published tables. Each level is the TYPICAL (average) round of a golfer at that handicap, compared with a typical scratch round. strokes_per_18 = 1.1 x handicap. That gap is split 25% off the tee, 40% approach, 20% around the green, 15% putting, following Broadie's finding that the long game is about two-thirds of the scoring gap and putting about 15%. 'adjust' is added per shot of that kind: ott per par-4/5 tee shot (14 per round), app per hole (18), arg per missed green (missed_greens_per_18 = 6 + 0.5 x handicap), putt per hole with putts (18). Change the numbers here to retune; past rounds recalculate.
